paragraphs: The Countertop Shop installs countertops in Enid and across NW Oklahoma, from a single bathroom vanity to a full kitchen remodel. The showroom on S 42nd Street has slabs, sinks, faucets, tile and flooring on display, so you can plan the whole room in one place.

Where the shop stands out is on difficult jobs. One customer's kitchen had unlevel cabinets, a large galley sink and three load-bearing posts. The crew templated carefully, cut the granite around every post, braced the bar, desk and sink, and hid the seams. She said they were fully equipped, experienced and did an exceptional job.

items.name: Granite countertops
items.blurb: Granite for kitchens, bars and desks, templated and installed by the shop's own crew. On one remodel they fabricated around three load-bearing posts, added braces under the bar, desk and sink, and brought extra hands to carry the heavy slabs safely.

image.alt: Granite countertops and bar on honey oak cabinets wrapping around wood posts in an open kitchen

items.name: Quartz countertops
items.blurb: Clean white quartz with soft veining for islands, perimeter counters and baths. Recent installs include a large island with an undermount sink on painted cabinets and a long white run over dark alder, both posted on Facebook.

image.alt: White veined quartz island with undermount sink on cream painted cabinets with turned legs

items.name: Backsplash and tile
items.blurb: Backsplash tile to finish the counters, from stone-look subway tile behind a range to full-height designs. The showroom displays tile alongside the countertop samples, so you can choose both together and see how the colors work side by side.

image.alt: Cream raised-panel cabinets with white countertop, stone-look tile backsplash and pot filler over a stainless gas range

items.name: Cabinetry, sinks and flooring
items.blurb: Beyond countertops the shop offers cabinetry, sinks, faucets, flooring and demolition. One Facebook post showed a full kitchen remodel finished for a local homeowner, with new cabinets, counters and backsplash in one job. Ask what can be bundled with your countertop order.

about.h2: About Tim Healy and The Countertop Shop
about.text: The Countertop Shop is owned by Tim Healy and works from a showroom at 310 S 42nd Street in Enid. The business describes itself as a kitchen and bath remodeling source for NW Oklahoma, offering countertops, backsplash, sinks, cabinetry, flooring and demolition. Its crew handles the whole countertop job, from templating to fabrication and installation. More than 2,600 people follow the shop on Facebook, where it shares kitchens and bathrooms it has finished and keeps up with the community, including messages of support after storms hit the area.

image.alt: Countertop Shop crew of five lifting a heavy granite slab into place on a kitchen bar

steps.title: Visit the showroom
steps.text: Come to 310 S 42nd St, Monday to Friday from 8:30 AM to 5 PM, to see slabs, sinks, faucets, tile and flooring.

steps.title: Design and choose
steps.text: Talk through your layout and ask questions. Tim has suggested ideas like joining two bar sections into one top.

steps.title: Template
steps.text: The crew measures and templates your cabinets carefully, planning seams, supports and how the slab gets into the house.

steps.title: Fabricate and install
steps.text: Your countertops are cut to fit and installed by the crew, with schedule updates along the way. Confirm all pieces are ready before install day.

items.name: Anne W.
items.text:
To say we are well pleased with our Countertop Shop experience would be a gross understatement. Owner Tim Healy patiently endured my endless questions, made great design suggestions such as joining the 2 sides of our bar to form a continent & gave me timely schedule updates.

From meticulous templating to flawless installation, the hardworking Countertop Shop crew expertly handled the many challenges of our job including our large galley sink & unlevel cabinets.  They precisely fabricated around the 3 load-bearing posts, installed multiple braces under the bar, desk & sink to ensure ample support, seams were strategically placed & inconspicuously joined and extra man power was on hand to safely handle the heavy granite.

We did not realize how much planning (I.e. will that big slab fit through the door), skill, special equipment and manpower is required to do this work well. The Countertop Shop are experts, fully equipped, experienced & do an exceptional job!  We are most grateful we entrusted our kitchen remodel to them & highly recommend the Countertop Shop without reservation

service_area.h2: Countertops in Enid and NW Oklahoma
service_area.text: The Countertop Shop is based at 310 S 42nd St in Enid, Oklahoma, and describes itself as a kitchen and bath source for NW Oklahoma. Its Facebook projects are posted from Enid. If you live outside town, call (580) 234-7131 with your location and project to check scheduling, or stop by the showroom on a weekday to see slabs, sinks and tile in person.

items.q: Do you do the installation yourselves?
items.a: Yes. Reviewers describe the Countertop Shop crew handling everything from templating to fabrication and installation, including heavy granite that took several people and special equipment to set safely. Ask during your visit how scheduling works for your job and who will be on site.

One kitchen had unlevel cabinets, a large galley sink and three load-bearing posts. The crew cut the granite around each post, braced the bar, desk and sink, and placed the seams where they are hard to notice. Bring photos of your layout to the showroom.

items.q: What else do you offer besides countertops?
items.a: Backsplash tile, sinks, faucets, cabinetry, flooring and demolition. The showroom displays these together, and reviewers mention the wide selection of products and faucets. That makes it easier to plan a full kitchen or bathroom update in one place, with one team to call.

Google lists the showroom as open Monday to Friday from 8:30 AM to 5 PM, closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (580) 234-7131 or email info@enidcountertopshop.com to ask a question or plan your visit. Bring measurements or photos of your cabinets so the team can help you compare options.

items.q: Will my kitchen and bath be installed on the same day?
items.a: Ask when you schedule. One recent customer had her bathroom top installed one day and the kitchen on another because the kitchen slab was not ready, so confirm that every piece is ready before your install date to plan time off work.

final_cta.text: Visit the showroom on S 42nd St or call to talk through your kitchen or bath.
